comply-in.span: Optimize for tokens per second per GPU, not just response time. PagedAttention and continuous batching squeeze maximum throughput from your hardware.
Explicit KV cache management and tensor parallelism to fit larger models into fewer GPUs, reducing cost per request.
Instrument every deployment with real-time token cost and GPU utilization metrics, so you know exactly what each query costs.
Graceful handling of OOM, request queue backpressure, and automatic scaling based on GPU load, not just request count.

p: vLLM is an open-source, high-throughput inference engine for large language models, built on PagedAttention for near-zero KV cache waste. It achieves up to 24x higher throughput than vanilla Hugging Face Transformers by continuous batching and efficient GPU memory management, making it the go-to choice for self-hosted LLM serving at scale.

vs-agency.p: Most vLLM deployments—single-model serving, throughput tuning, GPU selection—are well within scope for a single experienced engineer working directly with you. An agency's advantage appears only when you need a full product team spanning inference, API development, and monitoring infrastructure.
